about: Rule cards of t4: each card switches one rule off in a scratch copy of the submission (lab ablate).

cards.rule: Before the system change of 2007-08-11 COBOL cut cents off and charged management fees by days / 360
cards.off: every charge computed like Neuron NG

cards.rule: The entry charge counts in the year of the trade date of the premium
cards.off: in the year the money was received

cards.rule: The monthly risk charge is at most the value left in the policy
cards.off: the full risk charge, even above the value

edits.old: return min(risk_charge(self.insured, tariff, value, insured_age, era_rounding(day_)), max(value, 0))
edits.new: return risk_charge(self.insured, tariff, value, insured_age, era_rounding(day_))

cards.rule: An individual agreement (NRAGRE) replaces the entry charge rate of the broker tier
cards.off: the rate of the broker tier for every policy

cards.rule: An individual agreement (NRAGRE) replaces the management charge rate of the tariff
cards.off: the rate of the tariff for every policy
